title: Kimi K3, and what we can still learn from the pelican benchmark
summary: Simon Willison analyzes Kimi K3, a new AI model, through the lens of the 'pelican benchmark' - a classic AI evaluation framework. The article explores how traditional benchmarks remain relevant for assessing modern large language models, even as capabilities have advanced dramatically. Willison provides practical insights on what we can still learn from established evaluation methods when testing new AI systems.
problem_solved: Evaluates whether traditional benchmarks like the pelican benchmark still provide meaningful insights for modern AI model assessment.
why_valuable: Offers practical guidance on AI model evaluation methodology, helping researchers and developers understand how to properly assess new models against established benchmarks.
